mentions.name: Health Connect Metrics GUI
mentions.description: A front-end to Google Health Connect that displays all the health metrics Health Connect holds in one GUI, bringing together data that individual health apps and vendors otherwise share or show selectively.
mentions.problem: Various health apps and vendors pick and choose what they share or show from other sources, so health data is fragmented across apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: A vibe-coded front-end to Google Health Connect that displays all health metrics that Health Connect holds in one gui.
mentions.author: hamilton_app
